# PyPI advisory IDs consciously waived. One per line, each with a triage note.
# cryptography 46.0.3 advisories — the engine uses ONLY the Ed25519 signing API
# (Ed25519PrivateKey/PublicKey + raw serialization); it never touches X.509 verification
# or PKCS#7, which is the affected surface of EVERY advisory below. A 50.0.0 bump was
# attempted (commit reverted) and broke the engine's governance runtime, so we waive
# these rather than force a breaking major for vulnerabilities the used surface can't reach.
GHSA-537c-gmf6-5ccf
PYSEC-2026-2141
PYSEC-2026-35
PYSEC-2026-36

GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5
